facts: Joel Kaso is a web designer from Albania. He designs, codes and sets up every site himself, so the client talks to one person. He works with clients in Albania, the UK, the EU and the USA, fully online.

He builds custom websites for hotels, guesthouses, restaurants, cafés, bars, salons, clinics, trades and other local businesses. No templates and no page builders: each site is hand-built, light and fast on phones, and tested with Google PageSpeed before it goes live.

Launch offer: a full website for €400, only for his first 10 clients (usually €800–1,200). It includes phone and desktop design, direct booking or orders, WhatsApp, a map, two languages and Google Business Profile setup.

Packages: (1) One-page site, for cafés, barbers and trades that need to be found and contacted: designed for phones first, WhatsApp and call buttons, Google Maps and opening hours, ready in about a week. (2) Business site with booking, the most asked for, for restaurants, salons and clinics: everything in the one-page site plus online booking with a calendar, a menu or price list the owner can edit, two languages, Google listing set up. (3) Hotel and guesthouse: rooms, prices and photo slides, direct booking requests to WhatsApp or Telegram, blocked dates the owner controls, a guest page with Wi-Fi and tips.

Features a client can pick: direct booking system, WhatsApp ordering, English and Albanian, a menu or price list they edit, Google Business Profile and local SEO, a photo gallery with lightbox, gift vouchers. Everything picked is included in the one launch price.

Timing: most sites go live in 7–14 days. Step 1: a 20-minute call about the business and its customers. Step 2: within 7 days the client sees a working first version on their own phone. Step 3: week two, full build and polish (booking, WhatsApp, maps, languages, tested on every screen). Step 4: launch day, live on the client's own domain with Google listing and a short video guide on how to edit it.
Payment: one fixed price, 50% to start the work and the other 50% only when the site is tested, approved by the client and ready to go live. No monthly fees to Joel.
Ongoing costs: no monthly lock-in. The only ongoing cost is the domain name, about €10–15 a year. Template platforms and agencies often cost €30–100 a month in plugins, hosting and maintenance.
Ownership: the client owns everything. The domain is registered in the client's name and the code is handed over, so they can move it or change designer whenever they like.
Editing: at launch Joel sends a short video showing how to change text, prices and photos in minutes, with no technical skills.

Bookings and orders reach the owner however is easiest: straight to their WhatsApp with the customer's details filled in, to Telegram, to email, or into a booking calendar. Direct bookings pay 0% commission, unlike booking platforms that take up to about 18%.
Security: no database and no plugins, so there is far less to attack and nothing to keep updating.
Languages: sites can be in English and Albanian. Joel replies within a day, in English or Albanian.

Case study: Hotel Kaso Ervehe in Përmet, Albania, Joel's family hotel and his first real client project. Up to 18% of every stay went to booking platforms. He built a fast site of its own in English and Albanian, a direct booking calendar, booking alerts on Telegram and the route on Google Maps.

Portfolio: the work grid shows the real client site Hotel Kaso Ervehe and demo sites with made-up business names: Ura Coffee Roasters (coffee roastery, Glasgow), Lule Balkan Kitchen (restaurant, London), Northline Barbers (Manchester), Avull Hammam & Spa (Edinburgh), Baltë Studio (pottery, Tirana), Dallgë Surf School (Newquay), Vreshta Estate (winery, California), Grusht Boxing Club (London), Shkumë Car Wash (Michigan), Pranvera Flowers (Bristol), Kala Build & Renovate (Birmingham), Aurelia Dental Studio (Leeds), Sage & Silk beauty studio (Bristol), Kalaja Bakehouse (Bronx, New York), Ullishta boutique hotel concept, Vjosa Rafting and Brolin Tattoo. Many have a full-screen scroll film in the hero.
Availability: Joel takes 2 new projects this month.
Contact: WhatsApp +355 68 572 7406, or the contact form at the bottom of the page. The Quick quote section on the page gives a price and timing in three steps and sends the brief to Joel on WhatsApp.
